title: Nitro Team
tagline: Chain Abstraction ledger layer for high-performance applications
description:
We have worked on building a network on top of multiple EVM chains which can create a virtual ledger to escrow funds into application with full blockchain abstraction. We are using our own implementation of state channels and have developped during the hackathon a RPC Message broker to simplify development of vApp for this Layer-3. This new Layer-3 uses no blockchain and allow fully peer-2-peer network performance, we are building a demo application along with the infrastructure of micropayment similar to lighting network but over multiple EVM.

We also have created a SuperchainERC20 token on unichain, base, world, polygon, celo
how_its_made: We are using our smart-contract erc7824/nitrolite and have build a go websocket service which allow to open state channels with web clients, they deposit funds to credit an account which they can use later to allocate on virtual account with other counterpary. they can then transact using our NitroRPC protocol to playmoney games, trade, make instant micro-payment while not having to worry on which chain the participant were connected from. we provide a typescript SDK, go types, an open-source RPC Message broker server and a micro-payment demo app.
